summary: Implemented `in` membership for namespace objects. Namespace.__contains__ in rdflib/namespace.py does prefix matching (str(ref).startswith(str(self))). ClosedNamespace.__contains__ does closed matching against stored term URIs in self.__uris, and _RDFNamespace inherits it. Container properties like rdf:_1 return False. Added NamespaceContainsTest to test/test_namespace.py covering Namespace prefix positive/negative cases, SH, RDFS (label True, example False), and RDF (type True, _1 False). Nothing was run because the task forbade executing repository code, so the tests and doctests are unverified. Nothing was committed.
